name: QLS
description: Ship and fulfil with Pakketdienst QLS from an AI agent: parcel shipments with labels and tracking, shipping products and delivery options, service points, fulfilment orders, fulfilment products and stock, backorders, returns and inbound purchase orders. HTTP Basic auth with the mijn.pakketdienstqls.nl login.
instructions:
## QLS
This connector uses the **QLS Fulfilment and Parcel Service API** of Pakketdienst QLS on `https://api.pakketdienstqls.nl` (OpenAPI at `https://api.pakketdienstqls.nl/swagger/`): parcel shipments with labels and tracking, shipping products and their delivery options, service points, fulfilment orders picked from the QLS warehouse, fulfilment products and stock, returns and inbound purchase orders. QLS publishes a v1 and a v2 API; the connector uses v2 where QLS offers it (shipment creation, returns, purchase orders) and v1 for the rest.

**Setup (about 5 minutes)**
1. You need an account on mijn.pakketdienstqls.nl. QLS authenticates the API with **HTTP Basic** and the login details of that portal. Use a separate user for the API where your account allows it (ask QLS IT support at it@pakketdienstqls.nl), so a password change of a person does not break the connector.
2. Put the user name (usually an email address) in `QLS_USERNAME` and the password in `QLS_PASSWORD`.
3. Install and run `qls_list_companies`. It returns the company id (a UUID) that every other tool takes as `company_id`; `qls_get_company` shows one company.

**Ids you need first**: `qls_list_companies` (company_id), then `qls_list_brands` and `qls_get_brand` (brand_id, needed for shipments and orders) and `qls_list_shipping_products` (shipping products with `combinations[].id` = `product_combination_id`, `options[].tag` = delivery options, prices per country and weight band). Look up pick-up points with `qls_list_service_points` or, for one product, `qls_list_product_service_points`, and pass their `servicepoint_code`.

**Parcel shipments (your own stock)**: `qls_list_shipments` (filter by status, reference, barcode, receiver, dates or `search`), `qls_get_shipment` (set `with_label` for the PDF and ZPL label URLs), `qls_get_shipment_return` (the return shipment of a parcel) and `qls_create_shipment`, which books the parcel and returns barcode, tracking URL and `label_pdf_url`.

**Fulfilment (stock at QLS)**: `qls_list_fulfillment_orders` and `qls_get_fulfillment_order` show status, ordered, reserved and delivered amounts and the shipments of each delivery; `qls_create_fulfillment_order` places an order, `qls_update_fulfillment_order` puts it on hold, releases it or changes reference, remarks or service point, and `qls_cancel_fulfillment_order` cancels it. Products: `qls_list_fulfillment_products`, `qls_get_fulfillment_product`, `qls_create_fulfillment_product`, `qls_update_fulfillment_product` and `qls_delete_fulfillment_product` (switched off). Stock: `qls_list_stock` (available, salable, reserved, incoming per product), `qls_get_product_stock` (per warehouse location) and `qls_list_backorders`.

**Returns and inbound goods**: `qls_list_returns` and `qls_get_return`, `qls_create_return_from_order` to announce a return; `qls_list_purchase_orders`, `qls_list_purchase_orders_in_transit`, `qls_get_purchase_order`, `qls_create_purchase_order` to announce goods coming to the warehouse, and `qls_list_suppliers`.

**Writes: confirm first.** Creating a shipment books a real parcel and costs money; a fulfilment order is picked and shipped from your stock. Before every write show the user what will happen (receiver, products and amounts, shipping product) and wait for a yes.

**Reading the answers**: every answer is wrapped as `{"meta": {"code": 200}, "errors": [], "data": ..., "pagination": ...}`; the data is under `data`, problems are listed in `errors`. Weights are in **grams**, prices and cash on delivery in **euros**, dimensions in millimetres. Ids of companies, brands, orders, products and shipments are UUID strings; shipping product and combination ids are integers. Fulfilment order statuses: error_validation, concept, received, pending, partically_sent (QLS spelling), sent.

**Paging**: lists return up to 100 entries per page. `pagination` carries `page`, `pageCount`, `count` and `nextPage`; call again with `page` + 1 while `nextPage` is true.

**Dates in filters**: the stock and purchase order filters take `d-m-Y H:i` (e.g. `1-10-2026 00:00`); the other date filters take a date or date-time such as `2026-10-01 00:00:00`.

**Errors**: 401 means wrong user name or password; 404 (`Niet Gevonden`) an unknown id or a company id that is not yours; 422 or a filled `errors` list a validation problem (QLS answers in Dutch).

**Switched off at install**: `qls_delete_fulfillment_product` and `qls_cancel_fulfillment_order`, which cannot be undone; an admin switches them on when the team needs them.
prerequisites: An account on mijn.pakketdienstqls.nl; the API takes the login of that portal (preferably a separate user for the API).

QLS_USERNAME.label: User name
QLS_USERNAME.help: The login of mijn.pakketdienstqls.nl you want the API to use, usually an email address.
QLS_USERNAME.patternMessage: Paste the user name alone, without spaces.

verifyHints.401: QLS refused the login. Check QLS_USERNAME and QLS_PASSWORD: they are the login details of mijn.pakketdienstqls.nl.
verifyHints.404: QLS does not know this id. Take the company id from qls_list_companies and the other ids from the list tools.

connector.name: QLS Fulfilment and Parcel Service API

tools.name: qls_list_companies
tools.description: List the QLS companies the API user may act for, with their id and name. Call this first: every other tool needs the company id it returns.

tools.name: qls_get_company
tools.description: Get one QLS company (id and name) by its id, to confirm which account the API user works on.

tools.name: qls_list_brands
tools.description: List the brands (trade names) of a company. A brand carries the sender, return and customs addresses and policies; creating a shipment or a fulfilment order needs its brand_id.

tools.name: qls_get_brand
tools.description: Get one brand (trade name) of a company by its id, with its name.

tools.name: qls_list_shipping_products
tools.description: List the shipping products (shipping methods such as DHL or PostNL parcel, mailbox or service point) the company may use, with their price per country and weight band, maximum dimensions, delivery options and the combinations of options. A shipment needs a product id and a product_combination_id from this list.

tools.name: qls_list_service_points
tools.description: Find carrier service points (pick-up points) near a postal code for every service point product the company has enabled, with address, opening times and the servicepoint_code to put on a shipment or order.

country.description: Two-letter country code, e.g. NL or BE.

postal_code.description: Postal code to search around, e.g. 1234AB.

tools.name: qls_list_product_service_points
tools.description: Find service points near a postal code for one shipping product (for example only DHL service points), with address, opening times and servicepoint_code.

postal_code.description: Postal code to search around, e.g. 1234AB.

tools.name: qls_list_shipments
tools.description: List the parcel shipments of a company with status (created, printed, pre_transit, in_transit, delivered, returned_to_sender), barcode, tracking id and tracking URL. Filter by reference, barcode, status, brand, receiver fields or created/modified dates, or search freely.

created_after.description: Only shipments created after this date, e.g. 2026-10-01 00:00:00.

created_before.description: Only shipments created before this date.

modified_after.description: Only shipments changed after this date.

modified_before.description: Only shipments changed before this date.

shop_integration_reference.description: Order reference of the connected web shop.

search.description: Free text search over the shipments.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. The answer carries pagination (page, pageCount, nextPage); call again with the next page while nextPage is true.

tools.name: qls_get_shipment
tools.description: Get one shipment with status, weight in grams, barcode, tracking id and URL. Set with_label to true to also get the label as a PDF URL and a ZPL URL.

with_label.description: true adds the label URLs (label, label_zpl) to the answer.

tools.name: qls_get_shipment_return
tools.description: Get the return shipment created for a shipment (status, barcode, tracking), when the consumer sent the parcel back with a return label.

tools.name: qls_list_fulfillment_orders
tools.description: List fulfilment orders (orders QLS picks, packs and ships from its warehouse) with status (error_validation, concept, received, pending, partically_sent, sent), receiver, ordered products, deliveries and their shipments. Filter by status, customer reference, brand, receiver fields or dates.

customer_reference.description: Your order reference, e.g. the web shop order number.

created_after.description: Only orders created after this date, e.g. 2026-10-01 00:00:00.

created_before.description: Only orders created before this date.

modified_after.description: Only orders changed after this date.

modified_before.description: Only orders changed before this date.

shop_integration_reference.description: Order reference of the connected web shop.

search.description: Free text search over the orders.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. The answer carries pagination (page, pageCount, nextPage); call again with the next page while nextPage is true.

tools.name: qls_get_fulfillment_order
tools.description: Get one fulfilment order with status, amounts ordered, reserved and delivered, receiver, products, deliveries and the shipments (barcode, tracking URL) that left the warehouse.

tools.name: qls_list_fulfillment_products
tools.description: List the fulfilment products (articles stored at QLS) with name, EAN, SKU, article number, total, reserved and blocked stock and prices. Filter by name, EAN, SKU, article number, stock levels or dates.

amount_available_greater_than.description: Only products with more available stock than this.

amount_available_less_than.description: Only products with less available stock than this, e.g. 1 for out of stock.

created_after.description: Only products created after this date.

modified_after.description: Only products changed after this date.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. The answer carries pagination (page, pageCount, nextPage); call again with the next page while nextPage is true.

tools.name: qls_get_fulfillment_product
tools.description: Get one fulfilment product with EAN, SKU, prices, stock totals and the warehouse locations (zone, rack, shelf, best-before) where it is stored.

tools.name: qls_list_stock
tools.description: List stock per fulfilment product only: total, reserved, available, salable, sold, backorder, incoming and forecast amounts. 100 products per page. Lighter than qls_list_fulfillment_products for stock checks.

modified_after.description: Only products changed after this moment, format d-m-Y H:i, e.g. 1-10-2026 00:00.

modified_before.description: Only products changed before this moment, format d-m-Y H:i.

created_after.description: Only products created after this moment, format d-m-Y H:i.

created_before.description: Only products created before this moment, format d-m-Y H:i.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. The answer carries pagination (page, pageCount, nextPage); call again with the next page while nextPage is true.

tools.name: qls_get_product_stock
tools.description: Get the warehouse stock records of one fulfilment product: per location the current and reserved amount, batch and best-before date.

tools.name: qls_list_backorders
tools.description: List the fulfilment products that are in backorder (ordered but not in stock) with the missing amount, to see what to replenish.

created_after.description: Only backorders created after this moment.

created_before.description: Only backorders created before this moment.

tools.name: qls_list_returns
tools.description: List returns handled by QLS (v2) with status (created, approved, rejected, partially_rejected, quarantine, incomplete, completed and more), the original shipment and order, consumer and returned products with reason. 100 per page.

created_after.description: Only returns created after this moment.

created_before.description: Only returns created before this moment.

processed_after.description: Only returns processed after this moment.

processed_before.description: Only returns processed before this moment.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. The answer carries pagination (page, pageCount, nextPage); call again with the next page while nextPage is true.

tools.name: qls_get_return
tools.description: Get one return (v2) with status, consumer, original shipment and order and the returned products with expected and received amounts and reason.

tools.name: qls_list_purchase_orders
tools.description: List purchase orders (announced inbound deliveries of goods to the QLS warehouse, v2) with status (created, in_transit, arrived, partially_arrived, processing, closed, archived, cancelled). 100 per page.

customer_title.description: Your title of the purchase order.

created_after.description: Only purchase orders created after this moment, format d-m-Y H:i, e.g. 1-10-2026 00:00.

created_before.description: Only purchase orders created before this moment, format d-m-Y H:i.

modified_after.description: Only purchase orders changed after this moment, format d-m-Y H:i.

modified_before.description: Only purchase orders changed before this moment, format d-m-Y H:i.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. The answer carries pagination (page, pageCount, nextPage); call again with the next page while nextPage is true.

tools.name: qls_list_purchase_orders_in_transit
tools.description: List the purchase orders whose goods are on their way to the QLS warehouse (v2), with deliveries, products and estimated arrival.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. The answer carries pagination (page, pageCount, nextPage); call again with the next page while nextPage is true.

tools.name: qls_get_purchase_order
tools.description: Get one purchase order (v2) with its products and amounts, suppliers, deliveries (barcode, estimated arrival, received) and labels.

tools.name: qls_list_suppliers
tools.description: List the suppliers of a company (id and name), used on purchase orders and linked to fulfilment products for reports.

tools.name: qls_create_shipment
tools.description: Create a parcel shipment (v2) and get its barcode, tracking URL and label URLs (label_pdf_url, label_zpl_url). Needs brand_id, product_combination_id (from qls_list_shipping_products) and the receiver; sender and return address default to the brand. Books a real parcel with the carrier and costs money: show the receiver, product and weight and get a yes first.

product_combination_id.description: Combination id of the shipping product and its options, from qls_list_shipping_products (combinations[].id).

receiver_contact.description: Address: {"name": "...", "companyname": "...", "street": "...", "housenumber": "12", "address2": "", "postalcode": "1234AB", "locality": "Amsterdam", "country": "NL", "email": "...", "phone": "..."}. street, postalcode, locality and country are required; country is a two-letter ISO code.

reference.description: Your reference, e.g. the order number.

servicepoint_code.description: servicepoint_code from qls_list_service_points to ship to a pick-up point.

cod_amount.description: Cash on delivery amount in euros, only with a COD product.

customs_shipment_type.description: Customs type for shipments outside the EU.

sender_contact.description: Sender address, only to override the brand address. Same shape as receiver_contact.

return_contact.description: Return address, only to override the brand address. Same shape as receiver_contact.

zpl_direct.description: true to get the ZPL label directly.

tools.name: qls_create_fulfillment_order
tools.description: Create a fulfilment order: QLS picks the products from its stock, packs and ships them to the receiver. Needs brand_id, the receiver and the products (fulfilment product id or EAN/SKU with amount). Starts a real shipment from the warehouse: show the receiver and lines and get a yes first.

receiver_contact.description: Address: {"name": "...", "companyname": "...", "street": "...", "housenumber": "12", "address2": "", "postalcode": "1234AB", "locality": "Amsterdam", "country": "NL", "email": "...", "phone": "..."}. street, postalcode, locality and country are required; country is a two-letter ISO code.

products.description: Order lines: [{"product_id": "<fulfilment product id>", "amount_ordered": 2, "name": "..."}]. Use the ids from qls_list_fulfillment_products.

customer_reference.description: Your order number, shown in reports and on the packing slip.

servicepoint_code.description: servicepoint_code to deliver to a pick-up point.

delivery_options.description: Delivery option tags of the shipping product, e.g. ["signature"]; see qls_list_shipping_products (options[].tag).

processable.description: Date and time from which QLS may process the order, to hold it until then.

total_price.description: Order total, for customs and insurance.

tools.name: qls_update_fulfillment_order
tools.description: Change a fulfilment order that has not left the warehouse: put it on hold or release it, change the processable date, your reference, the remarks or the service point. Confirm the change with the user first.

hold.description: true holds the order, false releases it.

processable.description: Date and time from which QLS may process the order.

tools.name: qls_cancel_fulfillment_order
tools.description: Cancel a fulfilment order that has not been shipped yet; its reserved stock is released. Cannot be undone: name the order and get a yes first.

tools.name: qls_create_fulfillment_product
tools.description: Create a fulfilment product (an article QLS will store and ship) with name, EAN, SKU, image and prices. Confirm the data with the user first.

tools.name: qls_update_fulfillment_product
tools.description: Update a fulfilment product: EAN, SKU, image or prices. Send only the fields to change and confirm them with the user first.

tools.name: qls_delete_fulfillment_product
tools.description: Delete a fulfilment product that has no stock or open orders. Cannot be undone. Installed switched off; name the product and get a yes first.

tools.name: qls_create_return_from_order
tools.description: Announce a return for a fulfilment order (v2): QLS expects the listed products back and processes them on arrival. Confirm the products and amounts with the user first.

order_id.description: Fulfilment order id the goods were shipped with.

client_note.description: Note for the warehouse, e.g. the return reason.

tools.name: qls_create_purchase_order
tools.description: Announce an inbound delivery of goods to the QLS warehouse (v2 purchase order) with the products and amounts, suppliers and the expected deliveries. Confirm the lines with the user first.

customer_title.description: Your title or number for the purchase order.

pre_order.description: true when the goods may already be sold before they arrive.
